title: brag
description: You can show off the item in your main hand with /brag, broadcasting a chat message with stack counts, rarity-colored item names, and hoverable tooltips, showcasing items from the inventory in chat.
body:
![The image is showing the output of the command /brag. You see the item in your hand, with rarity colors and lore.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/65731c9f2dc1491030e8171d2d323fc98609ebab.png)

brag adds a simple `/brag` command that lets players show off the item in their main hand in chat. The message includes the item stack count, rarity-colored item name, and a hoverable tooltip so other players can inspect the item details directly from chat.

It is meant as a lightweight quality-of-life command for sharing interesting loot, gear, tools, or weird items without needing everyone to be nearby.

This mod allows showcasing items from the inventory in chat.

Supports vanilla items, renamed/lore/customized items, and modded items (when the client can display them).


- Show your held item with `/brag`
- Displays stack counts, such as `64x Firework Rocket`
- Uses Minecraft rarity colors for item names
- Shows hoverable item tooltips in chat
